source.note: The classification is published as an image; its figures are read from it and quoted as printed. Tier pcb_proto is the PCB proto service (pattern class 6, drill class C); tier standard is STANDARD pool (pattern class 8, drill class E). Base copper raises the pattern minimum: 35 µm base needs 0.125 mm.
